gen-gf-offside-gf-ubuntu-sans: Commanding curves that never quite close give Offside a wide, loose swagger in the heading. And Ubuntu Sans counters with big round eyes and tubular strokes, a modern sans-serif that does the quiet work of carrying the text.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-tiktok-sans: Oxanium's diagonals hit as hard as its verticals, all in one clean line. TikTok Sans brings a tall, spacious lowercase that lets that sharp heading keep its edge without crowding anything beside it.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-vend-sans: Scattered letters, lowercase swollen to capital size. Vend Sans keeps a ruler-straight line with curves that never thin at the turns, and that steadiness is what makes Paprika's looseness feel intentional.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-sulphur-point: Bold, wide-striding Revalia spreads its letters out with a lazy, confident gait, and its open-bottomed g is hard to miss. Sulphur Point answers in a marker-like sans with bulky lowercase, so shrinking the heading would lose what makes it stand out.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-yaldevi: Yaldevi reads as a plain sans with outsized lowercase and an e whose eye opens clearly to the right. Snowburst One, stencil-cut and tall, handles the shouting.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-stack-sans-text: Stack Sans Text draws a marker-like constant line, with big-bodied lowercase and curve endings kept well apart. And Tektur above it, bent like pipe cleaner, gives the reading a wiry spark without upsetting a long page.
gen-nixie-one-archivo: Nostalgic pencil-thin lines in Nixie One look like an old technical readout, open and unhurried. Archivo is the opposite in build, with a tall lowercase that carries the words.
gen-nixie-one-fs-asap: Nixie One draws every stroke as a single thin line. Asap has a body height nearly matching its capitals, so it can stay modest in size and still read clearly under that fragile heading.
gen-nixie-one-fs-epilogue: Nixie One traces open curves in a thin, constant stroke with a retro-tech flavor. But Epilogue has curvy, tall-bodied lowercase with stubby ascender tips, so the heading looks delicate while the text below feels sturdy.
gen-nixie-one-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans reads as a plain sans with wide-open s curves and an x-height larger than usual. Nixie One is best at hairline, nostalgic display lines, while Fira Sans does its best work carrying the sentences.
